settings.question_faqs: Will your template be fully compatible with Shopify?
I cannot upload the theme to my Shopify store / Shopify alerts that the file is too big to upload, what is the problem?
settings.answer_faqs:
Please make sure that you follow below steps:

1/ Download the package from themeforest.net (the file is in zip format)

2/ Extract the file you've just downloaded.

3/ Find this file: belle-dolls-1.0.0-sections-ready.zip in the folder Ella Sections Ready 3.0.0, then you just need to upload belle-dolls-1.0.0-sections-ready.zip file to your Shopify store.

settings.question_faqs: What I have to do when I need your support?
settings.answer_faqs:
To save your time and reach our support quickly, please follow below steps:

1/ Create a staff account for us (with Themes permission and Settings permission) http://docs.shopify.com/manual/settings/account/staff-members

2/ Capture screenshot or video for the issue you get.

3/ Specify which template and version you are using.

4/ Describe clearly how to reproduce the issue.

5/ Send all information (staff account, screenshot, video, template name and version, description of the issues, link) to support@halothemes.com

settings.question_faqs: Would assistance be available to upload the template if needed?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, we will assist you to install the template if needed

settings.question_faqs: Do you guys offer customisation services for your themes?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, we do. Please send your customisation requests to support@halothemes.com, we will give you our quote. Thank you.

settings.question_faqs: Can I turn on/off Lazy Loading Image / Item Animation / Fade Up on the page?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes. You can turn on/off the animation in the Setting page.

settings.question_faqs: Can I turn on/off some blocks on the page?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes. You can turn on/off almost any blocks on the page (featured products, slideshow, banners, related products, recent products,...).

settings.question_faqs: I want to have the dropdown cart displayed automatically every time clients hover over it (instead of clicking on it). Is it possible?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, we have a setting for you to switch between these two options: Display on Hover and Display on Click.

settings.question_faqs: What is included in the theme package?
settings.answer_faqs: The theme package includes theme source, Photoshop design files, sample data and manual guide.

settings.question_faqs: I notice that the images used in the theme are all portrait. Will that be a problem if I use square images for our products? How will they be displayed in the theme?
settings.answer_faqs: That is not a problem. You just need to modify the width/height ratio in theme settings.

settings.question_faqs: Does the theme support image resizing and cropping?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes. Normally, the theme will resize images to a default size (based on your width/height ratio setting). We also have Crop setting if you don’t want to scale the image.

settings.question_faqs: Can I add borders around our product images?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, you can. You can also set image border colours.

settings.question_faqs: Can I have multi level menu?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, you can. Just simply follow the instructions in our Manual Guide, you will be able to easily create a multi-level menu.

settings.question_faqs: Do you guys provide customer support during weekends / holidays?
settings.answer_faqs: Normally we don't provide support during weekends, except for urgent cases. In these cases, you only need to mark “Urgent” in your email, we will get back to you ASAP.

settings.question_faqs: Does the theme support Variant Image?
settings.answer_faqs: Yes, it does. Please check it out here to see how it works: https://sneake-demo.myshopify.com/products/sample-proin-de-corper-nulla-dan-melementum-1?variant=10214763888684

settings.product_tab_content:
S H I P P I N G & D E L I V E R Y

All prints are made to order.

Framed orders will be shipped within 14 days days from the day your payment has been received, unless otherwise notified. Unframed print orders will be shipped within 7-10 days from the day your payment has been received, unless otherwise notified.

All images are carefully wrapped prior to shipping. Orders will be delivered by regular mail. However, for extra security, you can purchase a shipping upgrade.

Your order will then receive a tracking number, which will allow you to trace your parcel.

Do you offer other sizes that aren’t in your shop?

We are always happy to discuss custom sizes with you - options may differ per image. Please contact us for a quote and note that larger items may be subject to a shipping fee.

Do the print images accurately display what the print will look like in person?

Due to differences in monitor calibrations, colors may appear slightly different on your screen than on your print.

Do you offer framing?

Yes! We offer framing on all prints. The standard frame option includes a 2 inch white matting but we are happy to discuss a custom framing order if need be. Our standard frame options are, white, black and natural wood. Each print/frame is made to order, in California.

How long will it take to receive my order?

Please allow up to 7 days for your print only order to be shipped and between 10-14 days for your order with frame. US and UK orders are shipped and arrive within 3-5 business days. Tracking details are sent to you via email.

How are the prints packaged?

All images are carefully wrapped prior to shipping.
Print only items are shipped rolled in mailing tubes and framed orders are packaged in a box.

Will I be charged sales tax?

Yes, if you are a California resident, 9% sales tax will be added to your order

Do you accept returns?

We are not able to accept returns or exchanges. Please contact us within 24 hours if an order arrives damaged. If your print is returned due to an incorrect shipping address, additional shipping fees will apply.

What if my print is damaged on arrival?

We always do our best to ensure that your order arrives with you safely. However, some items can be damaged in transit. Please keep all original packaging and contact us within 24 hours of receipt with images showing any damage. We do offer shipping protection from Route. This covers your item against damage, loss or theft. You can add this at checkout for $0.98

What are the exact dimensions of the framed prints?

Outside frame measurements are:
13.5x17.5in (8x12in print)
17.5x23.5in (12x18in print)
26x36in (20x30in print)
30x42in (24x36in print)

Where are the prints made?

All items are made here in the USA - both framed and unframed items.

about charlotte lea


I'm Charlotte — a British-born interior and architectural photographer based in Southern California.

Growing up surrounded by thoughtful, intentional design gave me a deep instinct for the relationship between form, light, color, and texture. That upbringing shaped the way I see spaces — not just what's in them, but what they feel like, and how to translate that onto camera.

Shooting hundreds of homes across California has given me a perspective that goes beyond a single project or aesthetic. I see design movements as they happen, across styles, designers, and spaces — and that informs every composition I create. My work has been consistently featured across leading US and international design publications for years — see my press page for the full list.

If you have a project that deserves to be seen, I'd love to hear about it.

settings.product_tab_content:
What is the process to rent from Charlotte Lea?

Renting from Charlotte Lea Photography is easy! Prop kits are rented as a bundle of 20 items at a one time cost. Charlotte brings the items to the photoshoot and packs and returns them once the photoshoot has ended.

Can I rent items if I do not have a photoshoot booked with Charlotte Lea?

At this time, rental kits can only be booked alongside a photoshoot booking with Charlotte Lea Photography.
If you would like to hear from us if that ever changes, please add your email address here

What if an item is damaged at the photoshoot?

That’s a bummer, but we get it, accidents happen! We’ll work with you to find a suitable solution quickly and (hopefully) painlessly, as our goal is always to make your rental experience the best it can be.
